nodes.title: feat(task-dashboard): add the sync engine and a fake acli [#1089]
nodes.body:
Closes #1089

## What & why

Adds the task-dashboard sync engine (`scripts/task-dashboard/sync.py`), a `dashboard.py sync [--mode …]` subcommand, and `dev/fake-acli` so a sync runs end to end without Jira. A run fetches everything first, then writes every mirror change in one SQLite transaction. `sync_runs` is written outside it, so a failure is recorded and the mirror is left unchanged.

nodes.title: feat(fleet): add machine snapshot builder [#1102]
nodes.body:
Closes #1102

## What & why

The fleet view needs the state that exists only on a machine. `scripts/task-dashboard/snapshot.py` prints one `schema: 1` JSON document of it: worktrees for every repo under `$HOME/src`, handoff front matter, tmux sessions, and cursor-tracked deltas of the session-state hook logs (#1099) and `~/.claude/history.jsonl`. Shipping it to the mini is task 6, not this PR.

nodes.title: docs(research): record whether a daemon can read the Remote session list [#1098]
nodes.body:
Closes #1098

## What & why

The fleet view's **Needs you** queue assumed a background daemon could read the
Claude Code Remote session list, `status_category` and `needs_action` included.
This research record tests that. Its verdict decides the shape of #1100.

nodes.title: feat(task-dashboard): add gh adapter for PR search and CI state [#1088]
nodes.body:
Closes #1088

## What & why

Adds the dashboard's GitHub source adapter, `scripts/task-dashboard/github_gh.py`. It finds my open PRs and the PRs requesting my review through a paginated GraphQL search, run once per configured owner because `gh search prs` returns no branch name. It reduces each PR's `statusCheckRollup` to `success | failure | pending | none`, and pulls allowlisted Jira keys out of a PR's title or branch. Every `gh` call goes through one fakeable `run(argv, timeout)` seam. Its signature matches the one #1086 specifies for `acli`, but this PR shares no code with that adapter.
